From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 8 Sep 2028 13:40:00 -07:00

Evan — quick technical summary as requested: 

- Logs & retention: Application and access logs retained for 13 months by default; retention policies can be extended for Dedicated/Private deployments per contract.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest for customer data keys; keys managed via KMS with HSM option for Private deployments.
- Data residency: Hosted inference runs in the region you select; by default our hosted US region processes US data only. Dedicated/Private options support customer-controlled region placement.
- PHI handling: Redwood does not perform downstream data enrichment on PHI unless explicitly enabled by customer config; we are willing to sign BAAs and have customers using Redwood under HIPAA workflows.
- Evidence notes: Bridge letter covers control coverage to the most recent audit period and is suitable for initial risk committee review. Final Type II will replace the interim documentation.

I've uploaded the bridge-letter stub and a short controls summary to the evidence folder Vanessa shared. If you'd like, I can join the walkthrough to go over the artifacts.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
